description:
Nestled on a unique waterfront peninsula in the prestigious suburb of Rochestown, Harty's Quay is one of Cork's most distinctive residential developments. Surrounded by the tranquil waters of Lough Mahon and Cork Harbour, this award-winning gated development offers a rare combination of peaceful coastal living and excellent connectivity to the city.

Residents enjoy beautifully landscaped communal gardens, secure underground parking, and direct access to the Passage Railway Greenway, providing scenic walking and cycling routes along the harbour to Cork City and Passage West. The development is ideally located just minutes from Douglas Village, Mahon Point Shopping Centre, Cork City Centre and a wide range of schools, restaurants, cafés and sporting amenities.
